name: Managed runtime artifacts
description: Preflight, ownership, reuse, budget, and finalization contracts for storage-intensive production projects.

invariants.title: Budget before the first large write
invariants.statement: Every storage-intensive producer resolves one owned root, estimates peak bytes, checks managed capacity and free-space headroom, and blocks before creating a large artifact when any input is unknown.
preflight: Name the producer, root source, artifact classes, estimate, capacity source, and interruption outcome.
Run the project storage review before executing the producer.
evidence: An over-budget run creates no large file.
A configured root never causes a sibling drive-root or repository-neighbor scratch directory.

invariants.title: Every retained byte has an owner and terminal state
invariants.statement: Successful, failed, and interrupted runs publish an owned inventory that separates truth, deliverables, caches, temporary files, evidence, and cleanup candidates.
preflight: Define the manifest owner and terminal states before production.
Define whether cleanup is report-only or explicitly authorized.
evidence: The final inventory matches the real filesystem delta.
Unknown, active, and unowned paths never enter cleanup candidates.

checks.message: Storage-intensive projects must own a reviewed storage contract.
Large writes must be blocked until deterministic storage preflight passes.
Cleanup remains report-only until exact targets are authorized.

manual_verification.title: Real producer storage chain
steps: Run the real producer once from its public entry and inspect the owned filesystem inventory.
Run the same content identity again and prove the large reusable object was not duplicated.
Run with an intentionally insufficient budget and prove rejection occurs before the first large file.

manual_verification.title: Interrupted producer ownership
steps: Interrupt a controlled production run after its manifest exists.
Prove the owner is no longer active and the remaining objects are reported without automatic deletion.
